source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-42

procedures.title: Folding top: adjustments
steps: Rear bow hold-down locks: shift the lock fore or aft within the slotted holes in the lock housing.
Turn the locating pins to change how hard the seal is held against the folding top lid.
Move the hold-down pins left or right to center the raised top on the body.
notes: (Hinge, continued) repositioning the hinge also corrects faulty fore/aft engagement of the rear bow hold-down pins in their locks, and a loose or over-tight top rear panel when the top is up and locked.
Centering the hold-down pins fixes poor alignment at the windows and pins that are hard to enter into the locks.

procedures.title: Folding top assembly: remove and install
steps: Raise the top but leave the header and rear bow locks unlatched.
Remove the rigid plastic trim (see Interior Trim).
Scribe the outline of each hinge plate on the lock pillar to record its position.
Remove the 2 screws holding each hinge to the lock pillar and lift the top assembly off.
To install, line each hinge plate up with the scribe marks on the lock pillar and fit the screws.
Adjust if needed (see Folding Top Adjustments).
notes: The whole top, frame with trim attached, comes off as one assembly.

procedures.title: Folding top trim and rear window assembly: remove and install
steps: Before removing the old trim, fully adjust the top (see Folding Top Adjustments).
Removal: take off the rear side rail window sealing weatherstrip (see Weatherstrip) and the screws at the ends of the header inner weatherstrip.
Pull the tacks holding the top and the header outer weatherstrip to the header (see figure 72 in the manual).
Peel the cemented trim off the rear side rail (Section C-C in figure 71).
Remove the wire-on binding end caps and the tacks holding the binding to the #3 bow (View F).
Remove the staples holding the trim to the #3 bow.
Remove the tacks at the upper ends of the stay straps on the #3 bow; pads may come off now if wanted.
Before removing pads and straps, mark their positions on the header (printed 'head') and #3 bow.
Unbolt the rear bow from the top frame: 2 screws each side (see figure 73 in the manual).
Carry the trim and rear bow assembly to a clean bench.
Remove the plastic filler from the rear bow weatherstrip, then pull the weatherstrip and trim off the rear bow (Section A-A; see figure 74 in the manual).
Installation: find and mark the centers of the header, #3 bow, rear bow and the front and rear edges of the trim.
Keep these center marks aligned throughout, rechecking often, especially while tacking or stapling.
Fit the top trim and weatherstrip onto the rear bow,
notes: Figure 71 in the manual identifies the parts and shows the lettered cross-sections (cut views; arrows show the viewing direction).
Mark the installed positions of loose parts such as stay straps and pads as they come off, to guide fitting replacements.
Do not remove the header weatherstrip completely: it must be in place during final trim installation to get correct trim tension.
See the Frame and Linkage portion for bow numbering.
